Alex P.: Hey team — customer ACCT-814 is seeing enormous HSM attach latency after we pushed a KMS rotation last night. They hit multiple 504s and some signing jobs timed out. Opening an escalation, need triage and repro steps.

Support Bot: Thanks for reporting — escalation ticket created #ESCL-2147. Please add logs and exact repro steps. :eyes:

Maria G.: Can you paste the client-side error and any HSM logs? Which HSM model/firmware and KMS provider?

Alex P.: Quick details: on-prem SafeHSM-X2 (vendor: VaultSafe), firmware 4.7.12. KMS rotation initiated by customer at 2025-11-18T02:04:12Z (their console).
Client errors (short snippets):
```
2025-11-18T02:05:01Z ERROR signing-service: rpc timeout: attach_key: context deadline exceeded
2025-11-18T02:05:02Z WARN signer: CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID during sign, retrying
2025-11-18T02:06:15Z ERROR signer: max retries exceeded -> 504 to customer
```

Alex P.: HSM syslog shows intermittent session evictions around the same window: 
```
Nov 18 02:05:03 safehsm kernel: hsm_session_evict id=0x3e7 reason=rotation_lock
Nov 18 02:05:03 safehsm kernel: hsm_attach_queue length=42
Nov 18 02:05:04 safehsm kernel: hsm_rpc latency=12.4s method=attach_key
Nov 18 02:05:05 safehsm kernel: ck_op_error code=0x57 description="session handle invalid"
```

Jordan (SRE): Are we sure the rotation triggered a reload that paused the HSM worker thread? Could be firmware behavior: rotation_lock followed by per-session eviction. Any recent firmware upgrades?

Alex P.: No firmware changes in the last 6 months. Customer did rotate KMS keys and our agent called into the HSM to import new wrapping keys. The attach backlog started within seconds of the import call.

Tim L.: Two quick hypotheses: 1) SafeHSM firmware serializes key import and stalls attach calls (rotation_lock entry suggests this). 2) Network/DNS flapping between host and HSM causing RPC retries and growing queue. Can you share packet loss metrics and host->HSM RTT during the window?

Alex P.: I pulled edge metrics: host->hsm RTT spiked from 12ms -> 220ms for ~90s. No packet loss but consistent TCP retransmits.

Maria G.: Ok. Next actions: (1) collect HSM debug logs around rotation (kernel + hsmd), (2) capture pcap of host<->HSM for 30s covering rotation, (3) enable PKCS#11 debug on signer for one minute to capture CK errors, (4) ask customer to reproduce on dev cluster with small batch.

Alex P.: Repro steps I gave the customer (they already reproduced):
1) trigger KMS rotation via console -> new wrapping key created.
2) call our agent: /v1/kms/import?wrap=true which performs a rolling import on the HSM.
3) concurrently send 50 signing requests over 60s.

Observed result: 30-60s window where attach latency jumps to >10s, queue length 30-50, ~20% of sign requests get CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID on first try.

Jordan (SRE): For immediate mitigation, suggest: increase signer session pool and add exponential backoff + jitter when CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID occurs. Also implement a short circuit fallback to software signer for low-volume critical paths.

Tim L.: Can we test whether routing the import calls to a staging HSM avoids the stall? If firmware serializes imports we could(off-hours) stagger imports or use our fallback import path that applies new wrapping keys without full worker pause. Need vendor confirmation.

Maria G.: I've asked vendor support (VaultSafe) to comment; ticket VS-9876 opened. They requested the pcap and kernel logs.

Alex P.: I've uploaded the logs to the escalation ticket and linked to customer repro recordings. Also included pkcs11 traces. Link: https://internal.redwood/escalations/ESCL-2147/logs :lock:

Support Bot: Vendor reply queued. Estimated response ETA ~2.5h.

Jordan (SRE): Action items assigned: Maria — gather pcap + pkcs11 debug. Alex — confirm whether customer can route imports to staging; collect exact timestamps. Tim — prepare a runbook for session pool scale and software-fallback. I'll draft a short customer note explaining transient delays and our mitigations.

Maria G.: FYI we should also check audit log retention: customer says some key-usage entries are missing for the 90s window. If the HSM evicted sessions mid-op they might not have flushed audit buffers — need to include audit log checks.

Alex P.: Confirmed: customer missing 02:05:03-02:06:40 audit entries for sign_ops. They have the import event but not per-sign entries.

Jordan (SRE): OK — that makes this an integrity/compliance concern. Escalating to security/compliance on-call and marking this P1 for audit completeness. Adding incident channel.

Tim L.: Noted. If audit entries are missing we may need vendor firmware patch or a customer-side workaround (buffered logging proxy).

Alex P.: I'll notify the customer that we have a vendor ticket and security is looped in; advising them to avoid wide-scale rotations during peak traffic until we have vendor guidance.

Maria G.: Thanks — keep updates in ESCL-2147 and paste vendor response when available. :thumbsup:

Support Bot: Closing the slack thread in 24h unless new info posted.
